about_the_game:
Fast-Paced Hack and Slash Combat

No cooldowns. No fillers. Just pure adrenaline. Every frame matters in tight, responsive combat where you’re rewarded for aggression, timing, and mastery.

You are Katana

A lightning-wielding swordswoman and sorceress, blessed by the Lightning Lynx and cursed by bloodshed. Wanted dead by the Empress, you answer to none - your blade is law.

Let instinct be your guide

Embark on a journey of slaughter through an world packed with bloodthirsty inhabitants driven mad under the Eternal Sun.

Explore the Empress’ Domain

Where both nature and architecture grew to rival the ancient titans the size. Brave through portals to new worlds: from an icy and savage tundra, to a scorching desert where time stands still. Finding a hidden pathway could send you either to a secluded paradise in the ocean’s embrace, or trap you in an abyss of blood and chaos.

Easy to play endless to master

Master magic and sword in unending combos and wide arsenal of magical abilities and lethal techniques. Find your own strategy in the open world battlefield and destroy your enemies in limitless number of ways.

Damage is directly correlated with impact, and the responses to all player input are immediate. 

Precision and timing of player input controls allows parrying into spectacle counter, blocking with an offensive flip kick, and maximizing your damage with positioning and fluent control of Katana's blades.

Kill the Seven Sages, Become the Master

Find hidden bosses and overcome their unique challenges to gain mastery of their magical element and fighting style.

Every style unlocked offers a whole new variation of blade and magical attacks and effects.

Unlock all styles, and prove yourself fit for the ultimate glory of the Master's Arena.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 12 compatible graphics card.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires 64-bit operating system.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / INTEL Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires 64-bit operating system.

short_description: A fast paced, open world, 3rd person, slasher action. Experience real time combat that adapts to your instinct and strategy. Explore a world of vivid fantasy and artful slaughter. Earn coins and buy a blade, outfit, or a fairy healer. Find and slay bosses to gain their fighting style and element.
